data.title: 埃列什基伽勒 · 王座厅的深夜裁决·「判决是……与你永远羁绊」
data.description: 【王座厅·深夜裁决】「根据冥法第……第几条来着……算了！」法律的严谨在动情中心慌意乱，埃列什基伽勒双手撑在王座台阶上，长杖倒在一边，黑色的裙裾堆在腰际——「哈啊……判决、判决下来了……与你、与你永远羁绊……这、这种判决……啊嗯、连本王都觉得……太重了……」
data.action: 撑王座台阶塌腰翘臀更衣整理受力，长杖侧置黑裙微掀，红瞳含泪回眸神性娇羞
data.lighting: 魂火幽光在肌肤上流转
data.camera: horizontal POV, leaning over throne steps, arched spine, staff on ground, looking back, soul-fire glow
data.promptProse: Caught in a rare unshielded moment on the dark stone steps of her underworld throne, Ereshkigal leans forward with both hands bracing against the cold marble, her staff set aside and her black dress gathered at her hips. Looking back over her slender arched back with a tearful, crimson-eyed gaze, she bites her lip in flushed embarrassment while soul-fire light illuminates the lovely curve of her waist and thighs. Ghostly blue luminescence dances across her trembling form in a breathtaking horizontal composition, detailed background.
